q: How much husk and power does a 2, 4 or 10 tph parboiling rice mill in Bargarh use a year?
title: Bargarh rice mills: husk and power by size
short: A 2 tph parboiling mill in Bargarh burns about 1,610 t of husk and uses 333,590 kWh a year, 512 toe. A 4 tph mill doubles that, and a 10 tph mill uses 8,048 t of husk and 1.67 million kWh. Husk gives 94% of the energy; grid power carries the fossil CO2.
audience: Parboiling rice mills in Bargarh district, Odisha, milling paddy for the public distribution system

ul: About 95 mills, all making parboiled rice, mostly for the state's public distribution system.
67 small mills of 2 tph make 343,855 t of rice a year, 45% of output; 19 medium mills of 4 tph and 9 large mills of 10 tph make the rest.
Husk is about 23% of paddy; about 90% is burnt in the mill's own boiler and the rest sold. Bran, about 7%, goes to bran oil units.
Boilers average 4 tph at 10 kg per cm2, mostly three pass and without an economiser.

sections.h: A year's energy by mill size
ul: Cluster: 241,445 t husk and 50 million kWh, 76,737 toe; 43 kWh per tonne of parboiled rice, about 0.1 toe per tonne in all.
Economiser and better condensate return, feedwater up to 90 C: about 10% less husk. Across 86 small and medium mills, 16,900 t of husk a year.
Solar water heaters for soaking water and boiler feed: about 20,000 t of husk a year.
Cogeneration: 3 mills already run 2 MW of captive power; the other 6 large mills could add about 6 MW.
Husk gasifiers for power from the husk these changes free up.

p: Husk you no longer burn can be sold, and a mill that also generates its own power buys fewer grid kWh, which is where its fossil CO2 sits. Husk CO2 is biogenic and reported apart; methane and nitrous oxide from burning it still count in Scope 1.

example.title: Fossil and biogenic CO2 by mill size (estimate)
lines: 2 tph: 333,590 kWh x 0.675 kg = 225 t fossil; husk 483 toe x 41.868 GJ x 100 kg = about 2,020 t biogenic
4 tph: 667,181 kWh x 0.675 = 450 t fossil; about 4,040 t biogenic
10 tph: 1,667,952 kWh x 0.675 = 1,126 t fossil; about 10,110 t biogenic
Per tonne of rice: 43 kWh x 0.675 = 29 kg fossil CO2
Cluster: 50 million kWh x 0.675 = 33,750 t fossil
example.note: Mill and cluster figures from TERI's Bargarh profile (2014-15). Husk energy is total toe less electricity at 11,630 kWh per toe; biogenic CO2 uses the IPCC 2006 default for solid biomass. Grid factor from CEA for FY 2025-26.
